hurts.title: More sensors, worse tracking?
hurts.alt: Three panels of one simulated target in the dense_clutter scenario of a synthetic world: range sensor only (baseline), camera added: worse here, and bias estimated: no clear change. Ground truth is dashed; each panel marks the 95% position uncertainty at the end of the track. Paired precision difference, fused against range-only: -0.478, 95% interval [-0.499, -0.457].

recovers.title: A camera that is slightly off, and a fix
recovers.alt: Three panels of one simulated target in the sensor_disagreement_within_gate_high scenario of a synthetic world: range sensor only (baseline), camera added: worse here, and bias corrected: partly recovered. Ground truth is dashed; each panel marks the 95% position uncertainty at the end of the track. Paired precision difference, bias-estimated against fused: +0.131, 95% interval [+0.100, +0.162].
